name: Bundle Sales Performance
query:
SELECT
  aib.bundle_name as "Bundle:Data:150",
  aib.bundle_item as "Bundle Item:Link/Item:150",
  aib.bundle_price as "Bundle Price:Currency:120",
  COALESCE(SUM(sii.qty), 0) as "Qty Sold:Float:100"
FROM `tabAccessory Item Bundle` aib
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
  ON sii.item_code = aib.bundle_item
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent AND si.docstatus = 1
WHERE (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
GROUP BY aib.name
ORDER BY SUM(sii.qty) DESC
